{{Quote|This meatless option comes from a pleasantly rustic Outer Rim agriworld. The patty is made from Agamarian soybeans and topped with a thick slice of binka fruit and mugruebe spit-sauce.|The Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Agamar sliders''' were a type of [[Diet/Legends|vegetarian]] [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. They contained an [[Agamarian soybean]] patty, a slice of [[binka fruit]], a [[Slider garnish|special garnish]], and [[mugruebe spit-sauce]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served Agamar [[slider]]s in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
Agamar sliders were [[Diet/Legends|vegetarian]] [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] consisting of an [[Agamarian soybean]] patty topped with a slice of [[binka fruit]] and [[mugruebe spit-sauce]], all on a trans-shipped medium-density [[foodboard]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the dish as a specialty, with the Agamarian soybean patty replacing the standard [[Mongo Beefhead patty]] served in most of the establishment's [[slider]]s. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] also added a [[Slider garnish|special garnish]] to the sliders, while [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] could be added upon customer request.<ref name="DaD" /> The sliders could be eaten by members of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Besalisk" />

==History==
Agamar sliders originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and were available at Dex's Diner on Coruscant. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the establishment's Besalisk proprietor and [[Chef/Legends|chef]], served the sliders fresh off the grill. He claimed they were delicious and inspired by his travels around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidalian]] mayo-ketchup and [[Bimm (disambiguation)|Bimm]] [[Mustard/Legends|mustard]] were available with the slider on demand. The sliders cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each and were served at the eatery<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="STB">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> Agamar sliders were also served at the [[Stargazer Grill Restaurant]] on [[Spaceport THX1138]] in the [[Earth system]].<ref name="ST:TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Agamar sliders were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" /> They were later featured as part of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', a ''[[Star Wars]]''-themed amusement ride that opened at [[Tokyo Disneyland]] in [[2013]]. A video highlighting features of the ride's THX1138 [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] shows a menu stating that the sliders were served at the restaurant on the [[Space station/Legends|station]].<ref name="ST:TAC" />
